dict.string: The on-device article-embedding feature (docs/article-embeddings.md) uses sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2) by the Sentence-Transformers project (Nils Reimers et al.), licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0). The model is converted to Core ML with the scripts under scripts/model/ and is downloaded on demand; it is not stored in this repository. The accompanying vocab.txt is the BERT uncased WordPiece vocabulary that ships with the model under the same license.
